subject: Request: Same-day demo (APAC hours) — possible tonight?
messages:
From: Danielle Park <danielle@greenwavehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
Cc: IT Admin <it_admin@greenwavehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 22:18:00 -0700
Subject: Same-day demo request (APAC hours)

Hi Ben,

Apologies for the late hour — I'm in Melbourne and we just wrapped an internal meeting where leadership asked to see Redwood in action today if possible. Is there any chance you or someone from your team can run a quick 30-minute demo this afternoon our time (between 2:00–4:00pm AEST)? That's roughly 11pm–1am Pacific where I know you are.

We mostly want to validate:
- Live generation latency for multi-turn chat
- How routing/fallbacks behave when a model is scaled down
- Integration with our SSO and expected data-flow (we have a short list of questions attached)

If tonight is impossible, we can do first thing tomorrow morning AEST, but leadership pressed for today. If it helps, we can be flexible on agenda and focus on a short walkthrough + Q&A.

Attachments: greenwave_product_questions.pdf (short Qs + SSO contact)

Thanks — Danielle
Danielle Park
Director of Digital Transformation, GreenWave Health
Mobile: +61 4 12 345 678
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.inference.com>
To: Danielle Park <danielle@greenwavehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Sep 2026 23:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Same-day demo request (APAC hours)

Hi Danielle — thanks for the note and for sending the questions. Appreciate the short notice.

Short answer: yes, we can usually accommodate same-day requests but need to confirm coverage from our Solutions Engineering team. I'm looping in Marissa (AE) and Aditya (SE) to check availability and who can lead the live session.

To make scheduling simpler, proposed slots (converted):
- 2026-09-11 14:30–15:00 AEST / 2026-09-11 21:30–22:00 CEST / 2026-09-11 00:30–01:00 PDT (same-day for you)
- 2026-09-11 15:30–16:00 AEST / 2026-09-11 22:30–23:00 CEST / 2026-09-11 01:30–02:00 PDT

If either of those works, we'll confirm and send a calendar invite immediately. If you prefer a slightly earlier time AEST, say 13:30, flag it and we'll try to adjust. Note: daylight savings differences between regions are in play this month — the times above assume AEST (UTC+10) and Pacific DST (UTC-7).

Marissa / Aditya — can one of you cover a short live demo tonight (my local late evening / your overnight) if Danielle confirms?

Also attaching a quick one-pager with our demo checklist for aligned expectations.

Attachment: redwood_quick-demo-credentials.txt (temp meeting creds — will rotate)

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.inference.com | +1 (415) 555-0112

Date: Sat, 11 Sep 2026 04:18:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Same-day demo request (APAC hours)

Ben / Danielle — I can take the 14:30 AEST slot (which is 00:30 BST for me). I normally avoid very late calls, but happy to cover this one since it's a short, leadership-directed session and GreenWave is a priority.

Aditya — can you prep the runtime/latency slides and be ready to share the console for 10–15 minutes? If not, I can run through the high-level demo and record the session.

A couple of asks for the session:
- Danielle: can you confirm expected attendee list (names + roles)? We want to tailor the demo to the right audience (tech vs exec).
- Please provide any SSO contacts in the attachment if we need to discuss direct integration details.

I'll be on the call 10 minutes early.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.inference.com | +44 20 7946 0999
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.inference.com>

Cc: Danielle Park <danielle@greenwavehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 11 Sep 2026 04:42:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: Same-day demo request (APAC hours)

Marissa — I can join and I'll prepare:
- Live chat demo with 3-turn context (showing token-level latency)
- A quick failover demo to illustrate model fallback behavior under simulated capacity constraint
- Bring a short slide on SSO/data flow and what evidence we can share immediately (audit logs, redaction controls).

I'll need console access to GreenWave demo account; Ben, do you want me to use the temporary creds Ben attached or should we wait for a dedicated guest link?

If everyone is happy, Marissa should lead, I'll do the SE portion, Ben can handle procurement/next-steps questions.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
